Subject: Request: Executive immersion at Redwood HQ (week of Mar 8)

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the runthrough last month — the execs at Catalyst want to come onsite for a condensed immersion the week of March 8. High level ask: 2‑hour executive briefing + 3hr hands‑on workshop with engineering leads, followed by lunch and wrap.

A few quick asks so we can lock the date:
- Preferred dates: Mar 9 or Mar 10 (flexible)
- Headcount: 8 people (2 execs, 6 engineering/product)
- NDA: we can sign your mutual NDA but will need it returned before booking travel
- AV: projector + HDMI + Zoom bridge for remote staff (1–2 attendees)
- Catering: brown‑bag lunch + one vegetarian & one gluten‑free

Can you confirm availability and any site access/badging requirements? If helpful I can loop in our travel admin but want to confirm Redwood logistics first.

Best,
Rachel

Sr. Partnerships Manager | Catalyst AI

Subject: Re: Request: Executive immersion at Redwood HQ (week of Mar 8)

Hi Rachel — great to hear, excited to host. Quick answers and next steps below.

Availability
- Mar 9 (Wednesday) 10:00–15:00 looks good on our side; Mar 10 has partial conflicts. Can you confirm Mar 9?

NDA
- Attached is our standard mutual NDA. If you sign and return via DocuSign link I can start badging. We typically need NDAs in place 5 business days before arrival for visitor processing.

Access & badging
- Guests will check in at Reception (main lobby). We’ll pre‑issue digital badges once NDA is received; physical badges picked up on arrival.
- Please provide full legal names, DOB (MM/DD/YYYY) for the badging form, and one phone number per attendee.

Rooms & run of show
- I’ve reserved Conference Room A (10p) for briefing + Workshop Lab B for hands‑on. Grace is adding AV spec and run‑of‑show now.

AV & connectivity
- Rishi: can you confirm HDMI adapters, capture (for recording), and a backup Zoom room?

Catering
- Grace will handle lunch orders — please send dietary restrictions. We can accommodate vegetarian, gluten‑free, and nut‑free options.

Attachments: redwood_run_of_show_v2.xlsx (stub), av_spec_sheet.pdf (stub), mutual_NDA_redwood.pdf (attached for signature)

If Mar 9 is a firm yes, I’ll put a tentative calendar hold and send the DocuSign NDA.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
